visualCharacteristics.purpose: Copy (intro, red check-circle list, CTA) beside a large image with an optional caption, ~50/50
visualCharacteristics.description: vs intro-box (~40%): no callout box; text + icon-check list + CTA beside a large product image, 50/50. vs intro-video (~60%): no boxed lead paragraph, image instead of video, check-icon list. Kept separate so the intro's lead box styling does not leak. | Same pattern as Biomek's media-split (copy + list | large image, ~50/50). Missing intro paragraph and button and an added caption under the image are content differences the block handles.

contentPattern.summary: Two 50/50 columns: left intro paragraph + 4-item list with red check-circle icons and bold lead-ins + 'Learn more' red button (#form); right large product image (Biomek i7 integrated system) | Two columns: left 6-item bulleted list; right chart image (click-to-zoom) with a caption paragraph
contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: (1) rich text (intro, list, optional button); (2) image + optional caption paragraph

reuseGuidance: Use for copy next to a large product image or chart. For video use intro-video.
